Who inspired who?

Tezuka (Astro Boy) was greatly inspired by Carl Barks & Floyd Gottfredson(*1)- two Americans. Manga & anime would not exist as it does now w/out Tezuka, & Tezuka’s style would not have come about w/out American Art. You could argue all of manga and anime is a reference to American Art
